description: Approve a staged automation script so it can run, using the ticket review_automation returned. Approving is what makes a script runnable; review it first to get a ticket.

script.description: File name of the staged script, e.g. 'close_stale_incidents.py'.

ticket.description: The ticket review_automation returned on a pass. It expires, is good once, and only covers this script at the version that was reviewed — edit the script and you need a fresh review.
